question: A company wants to use large language models (LLMs) with Amazon Bedrock to develop a chat interface for the company's product manuals. The manuals are stored as PDF files. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use prompt engineering to add one PDF file as context to the user prompt when the prompt is submitted to Amazon Bedrock.
options.B: Use prompt engineering to add all the PDF files as context to the user prompt when the prompt is submitted to Amazon Bedrock.
options.C: Use all the PDF documents to fine-tune a model with Amazon Bedrock. Use the fine-tuned model to process user prompts.
options.D: Upload PDF documents to an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Use the knowledge base to provide context when users submit prompts to Amazon Bedrock.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用提示工程（prompt engineering），在用戶提交提示到Amazon Bedrock时，将一个PDF文件作为上下文添加到用戶提示中。 正确性分析：虽然可以通过提示工程将单个PDF文件作为上下文，但这种方法无法扩展到多个文件，且需要用戶每次手动选择相关 文件，效率低下。 成本效益：不适合处理大量PDF文件，操作复杂且不具备自动化能力。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用提示工程（prompt engineering），在用戶提交提示到Amazon Bedrock时，将所有PDF文件作为上下文添加到用戶提示中。 正确性分析：将所有PDF文件作为上下文可能导致提示过于冗⻓，超出LLM的上下文窗口限制，且无法有效处理大量数据。 成本效益：不具备可扩展性，处理大量文件时成本高昂且效率低。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用所有PDF文档通过Amazon Bedrock对模型进行微调。使用微调后的模型来处理用戶提示。 正确性分析：微调模型可以使其适应特定数据，但Amazon Bedrock的设计是为了避免用戶进行复杂的模型微调，且微调成本较高。 成本效益：微调需要大量计算资源，成本高昂，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Correct. 将PDF文档上传到Amazon Bedrock知识库中。使用知识库在用戶提交提示到Amazon Bedrock时提供上下文。 正确性分析：Amazon Bedrock支持集成外部知识库，用戶可以上传PDF文件并通过知识库提供上下文。这种方法高效且自动化，适合 处理大量文档。 成本效益：无需微调模型，直接利用知识库功能，成本最低且操作简单。 结论：正确。

question: A social media company wants to use a large language model (LLM) for content moderation. The company wants to evaluate the LLM outputs for bias and potential discrimination against specific groups or individuals. Which data source should the company use to evaluate the LLM outputs with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.A: User-generated content
options.B: Moderation logs
options.C: Content moderation guidelines
options.D: Benchmark datasets

explanations.A: Incorrect. User-generated content 用戶生成内容 错误：用戶生成内容可能包含大量噪声数据，且需要额外的处理和标注工作，增加了行政管理的复杂性。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Moderation logs 审核日志 错误：审核日志通常是针对过去的内容进行记录，可能不适合直接评估模型输出的偏⻅和歧视。此外，审核日志可能需要额外的权 限和管理工作。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Content moderation guidelines 内容审核指南 错误：内容审核指南是规则和政策的集合，不能直接作为数据源来评估模型输出。
explanations.D: Correct. Benchmark datasets 基准数据集 正确：基准数据集通常是预先标注好的数据，专⻔用于评估模型性能，包括偏⻅和歧视检测。这种数据集可以直接使用，减少了行 政管理工作量。

question: A company wants to use a pre-trained generative AI model to generate content for its marketing campaigns. The company needs to ensure that the generated content aligns with the company's brand voice and messaging requirements. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Optimize the model's architecture and hyperparameters to improve the model's overall performance.
options.B: Increase the model's complexity by adding more layers to the model's architecture.
options.C: Create effective prompts that provide clear instructions and context to guide the model's generation.
options.D: Select a large, diverse dataset to pre-train a new generative model.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 优化模型的架构和超参数以提高模型的整体性能。 错误：优化模型架构和超参数通常用于训练或微调模型以提高性能，但本题明确提到使用预训练模型，而不是重新训练或微调模 型。 与题目需求不符，因为优化架构和超参数无法直接确保生成内容符合品牌语调。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 通过在模型架构中添加更多层来增加模型的复杂性。 错误：增加模型复杂性可能提高模型的表达能力，但这需要重新训练模型，并且与题目中“使用预训练模型”的要求不符。 此外，增加复杂性并不能直接解决生成内容与品牌语调匹配的问题。
explanations.C: Correct. 创建有效的提示，提供清晰的指令和上下文以引导模型的生成。 正确：提示工程（Prompt Engineering）是使用预训练模型时最有效的方法之一，可以通过设计清晰的指令和上下文来引导模型生成 符合品牌语调的内容。 与题目需求完全匹配，因为它直接解决了如何确保生成内容符合品牌语调的问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 选择一个大型、多样化的数据集来预训练一个新的生成模型。 错误：预训练一个新的生成模型需要大量资源和时间，与题目中“使用预训练模型”的要求不符。 此外，重新训练模型并不能直接解决生成内容与品牌语调匹配的问题。

question: A loan company is building a generative AI-based solution to offer new applicants discounts based on specific business criteria. The company wants to build and use an AI model responsibly to minimize bias that could negatively affect some customers. Which actions should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Detect imbalances or disparities in the data.
options.B: Ensure that the model runs frequently.
options.C: Evaluate the model's behavior so that the company can provide transparency to stakeholders.
options.D: Use the Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) technique to ensure that the model is 100% accurate.
options.E: Ensure that the model's inference time is within the accepted limits.

explanations.A: Correct. Detect imbalances or disparities in the data. 正确。检测数据中的不平衡或差异是负责任的AI开发的关键步骤，可以帮助减少模型偏差并确保公平性。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Ensure that the model runs frequently. 错误。频繁运行模型与减少偏差或负责任的AI开发无直接关联。
explanations.C: Correct. Evaluate the model's behavior so that the company can provide transparency to stakeholders. 正确。评估模型行为以提供透明性是负责任的AI开发的重要组成部分，有助于向利益相关者展示模型的公平性和可靠性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Use the Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) technique to ensure that the model is 100% accurate. 错误。ROUGE技术主要用于评估文本生成模型的质量，而不是用于减少偏差或确保公平性。此外，模型100%准确通常是不现实的目 标。
explanations.E: Incorrect. Ensure that the model's inference time is within the accepted limits. 错误。推理时间的优化与减少偏差或负责任的AI开发无直接关联。

question: A company is using an Amazon Bedrock base model to summarize documents for an internal use case. The company trained a custom model to improve the summarization quality. Which action must the company take to use the custom model through Amazon Bedrock?

options.A: Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model.
options.B: Deploy the custom model in an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference.
options.C: Register the model with the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry.
options.D: Grant access to the custom model in Amazon Bedrock.

explanations.A: Correct. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model. 正确。Amazon Bedrock允许用戶使用基础模型或自定义模型进行推理。为了使用自定义模型，用戶需要购买Provisioned Throughput以 确保模型能够处理请求并提供稳定的性能。这是正确的操作步骤。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Deploy the custom model in an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference. 错误。虽然Amazon SageMaker可以用于部署自定义模型，但题目明确提到使用Amazon Bedrock进行推理，而不是通过SageMaker端点 进行实时推理。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Register the model with the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry. 错误。Amazon SageMaker Model Registry用于管理模型的版本和生命周期，但与Amazon Bedrock的直接使用无关。题目没有提到需要 使用Model Registry。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Grant access to the custom model in Amazon Bedrock. 错误。虽然授予访问权限是必要的，但题目中并未提到需要单独执行此操作。正确的步骤是购买Provisioned Throughput，而不是单独 授予访问权限。

question: A company needs to choose a model from Amazon Bedrock to use internally. The company must identify a model that generates responses in a style that the company's employees prefer. What should the company do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Evaluate the models by using built-in prompt datasets.
options.B: Evaluate the models by using a human workforce and custom prompt datasets.
options.C: Use public model leaderboards to identify the model.
options.D: Use the model InvocationLatency runtime metrics in Amazon CloudWatch when trying models.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Evaluate the models by using built-in prompt datasets. 错误：内置的提示数据集可能无法反映公司员工的具体偏好，因为这些数据集是通用的，无法针对公司特定需求进行定制。
explanations.B: Correct. Evaluate the models by using a human workforce and custom prompt datasets. 正确：使用人工劳动力和自定义提示数据集可以确保评估过程针对公司员工的具体需求和偏好。人工评估可以提供主观反馈，而自 定义数据集可以模拟公司内部的实际使用场景。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Use public model leaderboards to identify the model. 错误：公共模型排行榜通常基于通用指标（如准确性或性能），而不是生成⻛格或特定偏好，无法满足公司员工的具体需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Use the model InvocationLatency runtime metrics in Amazon CloudWatch when trying models. 错误：InvocationLatency 运行时指标仅反映模型的性能（如响应时间），而不是生成⻛格或内容质量，无法满足题目要求。

question: A student at a university is copying content from generative AI to write essays. Which challenge of responsible generative AI does this scenario represent?

options.A: Toxicity Toxicity
options.B: Hallucinations Hallucinations
options.C: Plagiarism Plagiarism
options.D: Privacy Privacy

explanations.A: Incorrect. Toxicity: 错误。Toxicity指的是生成式AI可能生成有害或冒犯性的内容，例如仇恨言论或不适当的语言。这与学生复制内容写论文 的场景无关。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Hallucinations: 错误。Hallucinations指的是生成式AI可能生成虚假的或不准确的信息。这与学生复制内容写论文的行为不直接相 关。
explanations.C: Correct. Plagiarism: 正确。Plagiarism（剽窃）是指未经授权复制他人内容并声称为自己的作品。学生从生成式AI复制内容写论文正是剽窃 的典型案例。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Privacy: 错误。Privacy指的是生成式AI可能泄露用戶的个人信息或敏感数据。这与学生复制内容写论文的场景无关。

question: A company needs to build its own large language model (LLM) based on only the company's private data. The company is concerned about the environmental effect of the training process. Which Amazon EC2 instance type has the LEAST environmental effect when training LLMs?

options.A: Amazon EC2 C series
options.B: Amazon EC2 G series
options.C: Amazon EC2 P series
options.D: Amazon EC2 Trn series

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon EC2 C series Amazon EC2 C系列实例是计算优化型实例，适用于高性能计算任务，但不专⻔针对机器学习模型的训练。它们缺乏专⻔的硬件加速 （如GPU或TPU），因此在训练大型语言模型时效率较低，且可能会消耗更多资源，导致环境影响较大。 错误原因：不适合训练大型语言模型，环境影响较大。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon EC2 G series Amazon EC2 G系列实例是图形处理优化型实例，配备了GPU（如NVIDIA GPUs），适合机器学习推理任务，但在训练大型语言模型时效 率不如专⻔设计的训练优化型实例。 错误原因：主要用于推理任务，而非训练任务，环境影响相对较高。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon EC2 P series Amazon EC2 P系列实例配备了高性能GPU（如NVIDIA V100或A100），适合深度学习训练任务。然而，与Amazon EC2 Trn系列相比，P系 列实例的设计未完全针对环境可持续性优化，可能会消耗更多能源。 错误原因：虽然适合训练任务，但环境影响较高。
explanations.D: Correct. Amazon EC2 Trn series Amazon EC2 Trn系列实例是专⻔为机器学习模型训练设计的实例，使用AWS自研的Trainium芯片。这些实例提供高效的训练性能，同 时优化了能源使用，减少了环境影响。 正确原因：专⻔设计用于训练大型语言模型，且具有最低的环境影响。

question: A company wants to build an interactive application for children that generates new stories based on classic stories. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock and needs to ensure that the results and topics are appropriate for children. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon Rekognition Amazon Rekognition
options.B: Amazon Bedrock playgrounds Amazon Bedrock playgrounds
options.C: Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock
options.D: Agents for Amazon Bedrock Agents for Amazon Bedrock

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon Rekognition: Amazon Rekognition是用于图像和视频分析的服务，主要功能包括面部识别、对象检测等。 与生成故事内容的适当性无关，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon Bedrock playgrounds: Amazon Bedrock playgrounds是一个交互式环境，用于测试和探索生成式AI模型。 虽然可以用于生成内容，但它并不提供直接的内容适当性控制功能，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock: Guardrails是Amazon Bedrock的一项功能，用于确保生成内容的质量、安全性和适当性。 它可以帮助公司确保生成的故事和主题适合儿童，因此此选项正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Agents for Amazon Bedrock: Agents for Amazon Bedrock是用于构建任务自动化的功能，主要用于集成生成式AI模型和其他AWS服务。 它不直接涉及内容适当性控制，因此此选项错误。

question: A company is building an application that needs to generate synthetic data that is based on existing data. Which type of model can the company use to meet this requirement?

options.A: Generative adversarial network (GAN) Generative adversarial network (GAN)
options.B: XGBoost XGBoost
options.C: Residual neural network Residual neural network
options.D: WaveNet WaveNet

explanations.A: Correct. Generative adversarial network (GAN) 正确：GAN是一种生成模型，专⻔用于生成与现有数据分布相似的合成数据。 GAN由生成器和判别器组成，生成器负责生成数据，判别器负责区分生成数据与真实数据。
explanations.B: Incorrect. XGBoost 错误：XGBoost是一种梯度提升算法，主要用于分类和回归任务，而不是生成数据。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Residual neural network 错误：Residual neural network（ResNet）是一种用于解决深度网络训练问题的架构，主要用于图像分类等任务，而不是生成数据。
explanations.D: Incorrect. WaveNet 错误：WaveNet是一种生成音频数据的模型，主要用于语音合成，但它不是通用的生成模型，无法生成基于任意数据分布的合成数 据。

question: A digital devices company wants to predict customer demand for memory hardware. The company does not have coding experience or knowledge of ML algorithms and needs to develop a data-driven predictive model. The company needs to perform analysis on internal data and external data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the data in Amazon S3. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using Amazon SageMaker built-in algorithms that use the data from Amazon S3.
options.B: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using SageMaker built-in algorithms.
options.C: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by using an Amazon Personalize Trending-Now recipe.
options.D: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Canvas. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by selecting the values in the data from SageMaker Canvas.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Store the data in Amazon S3. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using Amazon SageMaker built-in algorithms that use the data from Amazon S3. 正确性分析：Amazon SageMaker内置算法确实可以用于创建机器学习模型，但这需要一定的编程知识和对ML算法的理解。 错误原因：题目明确指出公司没有编码经验或ML算法知识，因此这个选项不符合需求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using SageMaker built-in algorithms. 正确性分析：Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler可以帮助用戶准备和处理数据，但它并不是一个无代码的解决方案。 错误原因：使用SageMaker内置算法仍然需要一定的编程知识，不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by using an Amazon Personalize Trending-Now recipe. 正确性分析：Amazon Personalize是一个推荐系统服务，Trending-Now recipe用于实时推荐，与需求预测不直接相关。 错误原因：此选项的服务和功能不适合需求预测场景。
explanations.D: Correct. Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Canvas. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by selecting the values in the data from SageMaker Canvas. 正确性分析：Amazon SageMaker Canvas是一个无代码机器学习解决方案，专为没有编程经验的用戶设计。它可以处理内部和外部数 据，并生成预测模型。 正确原因：此选项完全符合题目要求，适合没有编码经验的公司进行需求预测。

question: A company has installed a security camera. The company uses an ML model to evaluate the security camera footage for potential thefts. The company has discovered that the model disproportionately flags people who are members of a specific ethnic group. Which type of bias is affecting the model output?

options.A: Measurement bias
options.B: Sampling bias
options.C: Observer bias
options.D: Confirmation bias

explanations.A: Incorrect. Measurement bias (测量偏差): 测量偏差通常是由于数据收集工具或方法不准确导致的。这与题目中描述的模型对特定种族的偏差 无关，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Sampling bias (采样偏差): 采样偏差是由于训练数据集中某些群体的代表性不足或过度导致的。这种偏差可能导致模型对某些群体 的预测不准确。题目中提到模型对特定种族的偏差，可能是因为训练数据中该种族的样本分布不均，因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Observer bias (观察者偏差): 观察者偏差是指数据标注或分析过程中人为主观因素导致的偏差。题目中没有提到人为标注或观察的 影响，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Confirmation bias (确认偏差): 确认偏差是指人们倾向于寻找支持自己观点的数据，而忽略反对的数据。这与题目中描述的模型偏差 无关，因此此选项错误。

question: A company is building a customer service chatbot. The company wants the chatbot to improve its responses by learning from past interactions and online resources. Which AI learning strategy provides this self-improvement capability?

options.A: Supervised learning with a manually curated dataset of good responses and bad responses
options.B: Reinforcement learning with rewards for positive customer feedback
options.C: Unsupervised learning to find clusters of similar customer inquiries
options.D: Supervised learning with a continuously updated FAQ database

explanations.A: Incorrect. Supervised learning with a manually curated dataset of good responses and bad responses 监督学习依赖于一个预先标注的训练数据集，无法实现自我改进。 手动整理的数据集是静态的，不能动态学习过去的交互或在线资源。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Reinforcement learning with rewards for positive customer feedback 强化学习通过奖励机制来优化行为，适合动态环境中的自我改进。 客戶反馈可以作为奖励信号，帮助模型学习更好的响应。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Unsupervised learning to find clusters of similar customer inquiries 无监督学习用于发现数据中的模式或聚类，但不涉及奖励或自我改进机制。 此选项无法满足题目要求的“学习过去交互和在线资源”的能力。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Supervised learning with a continuously updated FAQ database 监督学习依赖于标注数据集，即使FAQ数据库持续更新，也需要人工干预。 此选项无法实现题目要求的“自我改进”能力。 因此此选项错误。

question: An AI practitioner has built a deep learning model to classify the types of materials in images. The AI practitioner now wants to measure the model performance. Which metric will help the AI practitioner evaluate the performance of the model?

options.A: Confusion matrix Confusion matrix
options.B: Correlation matrix Correlation matrix
options.C: R2 score R2 score
options.D: Mean squared error (MSE) Mean squared error (MSE)

explanations.A: Correct. Confusion matrix: 正确。混淆矩阵是分类问题中常用的性能评估工具，它可以显示模型预测的正确和错误分类情况，包括TP（True Positive）、FP（False Positive）、TN（True Negative）、FN（False Negative）。对于分类问题，这是最合适的评估工具。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Correlation matrix: 错误。相关矩阵用于显示变量之间的相关性，通常用于数据分析阶段，而不是模型性能评估。
explanations.C: Incorrect. R2 score: 错误。R2分数是回归问题的评估指标，适用于预测连续值，而不是分类问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Mean squared error (MSE): 错误。均方误差是回归问题的评估指标，适用于预测连续值，而不是分类问题。

question: A company has built a chatbot that can respond to natural language questions with images. The company wants to ensure that the chatbot does not return inappropriate or unwanted images. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement moderation APIs.
options.B: Retrain the model with a general public dataset.
options.C: Perform model validation.
options.D: Automate user feedback integration.

explanations.A: Correct. Implement moderation APIs. 实施moderation APIs。 正确：AWS提供了Moderation APIs（例如Amazon Rekognition），可以自动检测图像中的不适当内容并过滤掉。这是解决问题的直接方 法。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Retrain the model with a general public dataset. 使用公共数据集重新训练模型。 错误：重新训练模型可能会改善模型的性能，但无法保证过滤掉不适当的图像。此方法不直接解决问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Perform model validation. 执行模型验证。 错误：模型验证是测试模型的准确性和性能，但它无法主动过滤不适当的图像。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Automate user feedback integration. 自动化用戶反馈集成。 错误：用戶反馈可以帮助改进模型，但它是一个被动的过程，无法实时过滤不适当的图像。

question: An AI practitioner is using an Amazon Bedrock base model to summarize session chats from the customer service department. The AI practitioner wants to store invocation logs to monitor model input and output data. Which strategy should the AI practitioner use?

options.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail as the logs destination for the model.
options.B: Enable invocation logging in Amazon Bedrock.
options.C: Configure AWS Audit Manager as the logs destination for the model.
options.D: Configure model invocation logging in Amazon EventBridge.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Configure AWS CloudTrail as the logs destination for the model. CloudTrail主要用于记录AWS账戶的API调用和活动历史，但它并不是专⻔用于存储Amazon Bedrock模型的输入和输出数据。 此选项错误，因为CloudTrail无法直接满足模型调用日志记录的需求。
explanations.B: Correct. Enable invocation logging in Amazon Bedrock. Amazon Bedrock支持直接启用调用日志记录功能，用于监控模型的输入和输出数据。 此选项正确，因为它是Amazon Bedrock的原生功能，最适合此场景。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Configure AWS Audit Manager as the logs destination for the model. AWS Audit Manager主要用于帮助用戶审计和评估合规性，而不是专⻔用于存储模型调用日志。 此选项错误，因为Audit Manager不适合此场景。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Configure model invocation logging in Amazon EventBridge. Amazon EventBridge主要用于事件驱动的架构设计，可以捕获和路由事件，但它不是直接存储模型调用日志的最佳选择。 此选项错误，因为它不直接支持Amazon Bedrock的调用日志记录功能。

question: A company is building an ML model to analyze archived data. The company must perform inference on large datasets that are multiple GBs in size. The company does not need to access the model predictions immediately. Which Amazon SageMaker inference option will meet these requirements?

options.A: Batch transform Batch transform
options.B: Real-time inference Real-time inference
options.C: Serverless inference Serverless inference
options.D: Asynchronous inference Asynchronous inference

explanations.A: Correct. Batch transform: 批量推理适用于处理大型数据集，尤其是多 GB 的数据集。 它不需要实时响应，适合离线处理场景。 此选项正确，因为题目明确指出公司不需要实时访问预测结果，并且数据集较大。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Real-time inference: 实时推理适用于需要低延迟响应的场景。 题目明确指出公司不需要实时访问预测结果，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Serverless inference: 无服务器推理适用于中小规模数据集和间歇性推理请求。 题目提到数据集是多 GB 的大规模数据集，因此此选项不适合。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Asynchronous inference: 异步推理适用于需要处理较⻓时间的推理任务，但数据规模通常较小。 题目提到数据集是多 GB 的大规模数据集，因此此选项不适合。

question: Which term describes the numerical representations of real-world objects and concepts that AI and natural language processing (NLP) models use to improve understanding of textual information?

options.A: Embeddings Embeddings
options.B: Tokens Tokens
options.C: Models Models
options.D: Binaries Binaries

explanations.A: Correct. Embeddings: Embeddings是数值表示形式，用于将真实世界的对象和概念映射到向量空间。这种表示方式能够捕捉语义信息，是AI 和NLP模型理解文本的关键技术。此选项正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Tokens: Tokens是文本处理中的基本单位，例如单词或子词。虽然它们是NLP模型的输入，但它们并不是数值表示形式，不能直接 描述真实世界的对象和概念。此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Models: Models是指AI和NLP的算法或架构，用于处理和理解数据。它们不是数值表示形式，而是处理数据的工具。此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Binaries: Binaries通常指二进制数据或文件格式，与AI和NLP中的数值表示无关。此选项错误。

question: A research company implemented a chatbot by using a foundation model (FM) from Amazon Bedrock. The chatbot searches for answers to questions from a large database of research papers. After multiple prompt engineering attempts, the company notices that the FM is performing poorly because of the complex scientific terms in the research papers. How can the company improve the performance of the chatbot?

options.A: Use few-shot prompting to define how the FM can answer the questions.
options.B: Use domain adaptation fine-tuning to adapt the FM to complex scientific terms.
options.C: Change the FM inference parameters.
options.D: Clean the research paper data to remove complex scientific terms.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用少样本提示来定义FM如何回答问题。 少样本提示是一种通过提供少量示例来指导模型生成答案的方法。 虽然少样本提示可以帮助模型理解问题的结构，但它无法解决模型对复杂科学术语理解不足的问题。 因此，该选项不适合解决此问题。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用领域适应微调来使FM适应复杂的科学术语。 领域适应微调是一种通过使用特定领域的数据对模型进行训练的方法，可以使模型更好地理解领域特定的术语和内容。 这是解决模型对复杂科学术语理解不足的最佳方法。 该选项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 更改FM推理参数。 推理参数（如温度、最大生成⻓度等）可以影响模型的输出⻛格，但无法直接解决模型对复杂科学术语理解不足的问题。 该选项不适合解决此问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 清理研究论文数据以移除复杂的科学术语。 清理数据可以提高数据质量，但移除复杂科学术语会导致模型无法回答与这些术语相关的问题。 该选项不适合解决此问题。 ( )

question: A company wants to use a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock for sentiment analysis. The company needs the LLM to produce more consistent responses to the same input prompt. Which adjustment to an inference parameter should the company make to meet these requirements?

options.A: Decrease the temperature value.
options.B: Increase the temperature value.
options.C: Decrease the length of output tokens.
options.D: Increase the maximum generation length.

explanations.A: Correct. Decrease the temperature value. 降低temperature值会使模型生成的结果更加确定性和一致性。Temperature参数控制生成文本的随机性，较低的值（接近0）会让模型 更倾向于选择概率最高的输出，从而减少随机性并提高一致性。因此，这个选项是正确的。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Increase the temperature value. 提高temperature值会增加模型生成的随机性，使输出更加多样化，但这会降低一致性。因此，这个选项是错误的。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Decrease the length of output tokens. 减少输出tokens的⻓度可能会限制生成内容的⻓度，但与提高一致性无直接关系。因此，这个选项是错误的。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Increase the maximum generation length. 增加最大生成⻓度会允许模型生成更⻓的文本，但与提高一致性无直接关系。因此，这个选项是错误的。

question: A company wants to develop a large language model (LLM) application by using Amazon Bedrock and customer data that is uploaded to Amazon S3. The company's security policy states that each team can access data for only the team's own customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Bedrock custom service role for each team that has access to only the team's customer data.
options.B: Create a custom service role that has Amazon S3 access. Ask teams to specify the customer name on each Amazon Bedrock request.
options.C: Redact personal data in Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow team access to customer data.
options.D: Create one Amazon Bedrock role that has full Amazon S3 access. Create IAM roles for each team that have access to only each team's customer folders.

explanations.A: Correct. Create an Amazon Bedrock custom service role for each team that has access to only the team's customer data. 正确：此选项直接解决了问题，通过为每个团队创建专属的Amazon Bedrock服务⻆色，确保每个团队只能访问自己的客戶数据。这 符合公司安全政策的要求。 Amazon Bedrock支持自定义服务⻆色，可以通过IAM策略限制访问权限。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Create a custom service role that has Amazon S3 access. Ask teams to specify the customer name on each Amazon Bedrock request. 错误：此选项没有明确限制团队对数据的访问权限，仅依赖团队在请求中指定客戶名称。这种方式无法确保数据访问的安全性，可 能导致数据泄露。 没有提到如何通过IAM策略或存储桶策略限制访问权限。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Redact personal data in Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow team access to customer data. 错误：编辑个人数据并更新存储桶策略虽然可以限制访问，但没有提到如何与Amazon Bedrock集成，也没有提到如何确保每个团队 只能访问自己的客戶数据。 此选项没有直接解决问题的核心需求，即基于团队的访问控制。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Create one Amazon Bedrock role that has full Amazon S3 access. Create IAM roles for each team that have access to only each team's customer folders. 错误：虽然为每个团队创建IAM⻆色可以限制访问权限，但Amazon Bedrock⻆色具有完全的Amazon S3访问权限，这与公司安全政策 相冲突。 此选项没有完全遵循“每个团队只能访问自己的客戶数据”的要求。

question: A medical company deployed a disease detection model on Amazon Bedrock. To comply with privacy policies, the company wants to prevent the model from including personal patient information in its responses. The company also wants to receive notification when policy violations occur. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Macie to scan the model's output for sensitive data and set up alerts for potential violations.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail to monitor the model's responses and create alerts for any detected personal information.
options.C: Use Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock to filter content. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms for notification of policy violations.
options.D: Implement Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect data drift and receive alerts when model quality degrades.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用 Amazon Macie 扫描模型的输出以检测敏感数据，并设置潜在违规的警报。 Amazon Macie主要用于识别和保护存储在Amazon S3中的敏感数据，而不是实时监控模型的输出。 此选项不适用于Amazon Bedrock模型的实时响应过滤，因此错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以监控模型的响应，并为检测到的任何个人信息创建警报。 AWS CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和用戶活动，而不是直接监控模型的输出内容。 此选项无法实现实时内容过滤和违规通知，因此错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用 Amazon Bedrock 的 Guardrails 来过滤内容。设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以通知政策违规。 Amazon Bedrock的Guardrails功能专⻔用于内容过滤，确保模型输出符合隐私和合规性要求。 Amazon CloudWatch可以设置警报，实时通知违规行为。 此选项完全符合题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 实施 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor 以检测数据漂移，并在模型质量下降时接收警报。 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor主要用于监控模型的性能和数据漂移，而不是内容过滤或隐私保护。 此选项与题目要求无关，因此错误。

question: A company manually reviews all submitted resumes in PDF format. As the company grows, the company expects the volume of resumes to exceed the company's review capacity. The company needs an automated system to convert the PDF resumes into plain text format for additional processing. Which AWS service meets this requirement?

options.A: Amazon Textract Amazon Textract
options.B: Amazon Personalize Amazon Personalize
options.C: Amazon Lex Amazon Lex
options.D: Amazon Transcribe Amazon Transcribe

explanations.A: Correct. Amazon Textract: 正确。Amazon Textract 是一种机器学习服务，可以从扫描的文档中提取文本和数据。它能够自动将 PDF 文件中的 内容转换为可处理的纯文本格式，非常适合处理简历的场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon Personalize: 错误。Amazon Personalize 是一种用于构建个性化推荐系统的服务，与文档处理无关。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon Lex: 错误。Amazon Lex 是一种用于构建对话式界面（如聊天机器人）的服务，与 PDF 文档的文本提取无关。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon Transcribe: 错误。Amazon Transcribe 是一种将语音转换为文本的服务，适用于音频文件的处理，而不是 PDF 文档的文本提 取。

question: An education provider is building a question and answer application that uses a generative AI model to explain complex concepts. The education provider wants to automatically change the style of the model response depending on who is asking the question. The education provider will give the model the age range of the user who has asked the question. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Fine-tune the model by using additional training data that is representative of the various age ranges that the application will support.
options.B: Add a role description to the prompt context that instructs the model of the age range that the response should target.
options.C: Use chain-of-thought reasoning to deduce the correct style and complexity for a response suitable for that user.
options.D: Summarize the response text depending on the age of the user so that younger users receive shorter responses.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Fine-tune the model by using additional training data that is representative of the various age ranges that the application will support. 错误：微调模型需要额外的训练数据和计算资源，且实现复杂度较高，不符合“最少实现努力”的要求。 虽然微调可以实现目标，但它并不是最优解。
explanations.B: Correct. Add a role description to the prompt context that instructs the model of the age range that the response should target. 正确：通过在提示上下文中添加⻆色描述，可以直接告诉模型如何调整响应⻛格，且无需额外的训练或复杂的实现。 这是最简单且有效的解决方案，符合“最少实现努力”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Use chain-of-thought reasoning to deduce the correct style and complexity for a response suitable for that user. 错误：链式思维推理虽然可以帮助模型生成更复杂的响应，但它并不能直接解决根据用戶年龄调整⻛格的问题。 此外，这种方法可能需要额外的逻辑设计，增加实现复杂度。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Summarize the response text depending on the age of the user so that younger users receive shorter responses. 错误：总结响应文本是一个后处理步骤，无法直接影响生成式AI模型的输出⻛格。 这种方法需要额外的实现步骤，且不如直接调整提示上下文高效。

question: Which strategy evaluates the accuracy of a foundation model (FM) that is used in image classification tasks?

options.A: Calculate the total cost of resources used by the model.
options.B: Measure the model's accuracy against a predefined benchmark dataset.
options.C: Count the number of layers in the neural network.
options.D: Assess the color accuracy of images processed by the model.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Calculate the total cost of resources used by the model. 计算模型使用的资源总成本。 错误。资源成本的计算与模型的性能评估无关。资源成本通常用于评估模型的经济性或效率，而不是准确性。
explanations.B: Correct. Measure the model's accuracy against a predefined benchmark dataset. 将模型的准确性与预定义的基准数据集进行比较。 正确。使用预定义的基准数据集是评估模型准确性的标准方法之一。通过比较模型预测与真实标签，可以计算准确率等指标。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Count the number of layers in the neural network. 计算神经网络中的层数。 错误。神经网络的层数是模型结构的一个属性，与模型的准确性评估无直接关系。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Assess the color accuracy of images processed by the model. 评估模型处理图像的颜色准确性。 错误。颜色准确性通常与图像处理任务相关，而不是图像分类任务的核心评估指标。

question: An accounting firm wants to implement a large language model (LLM) to automate document processing. The firm must proceed responsibly to avoid potential harms. What should the firm do when developing and deploying the LLM? (Choose two.)

options.A: Include fairness metrics for model evaluation.
options.B: Adjust the temperature parameter of the model.
options.C: Modify the training data to mitigate bias.
options.D: Avoid overfitting on the training data.

explanations.A: Correct. Include fairness metrics for model evaluation. 正确。公平性指标是负责任AI开发的重要组成部分，用于评估模型是否对不同群体公平，避免潜在的歧视或偏差。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Adjust the temperature parameter of the model. 错误。调整温度参数主要影响生成文本的随机性或创造性，与负责任AI开发和偏差减轻无直接关系。
explanations.C: Correct. Modify the training data to mitigate bias. 正确。修改训练数据以减轻偏差是负责任AI开发的核心步骤，可以帮助减少模型在生成结果时的偏⻅。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Avoid overfitting on the training data. 错误。虽然避免过拟合是机器学习中的重要原则，但它与负责任AI开发的具体目标（如公平性和偏差减轻）无直接关联。
explanations.E: Incorrect. Apply prompt engineering techniques. 错误。提示工程主要用于优化模型的输出，与负责任AI开发的目标无直接关系。

question: A company is building an ML model. The company collected new data and analyzed the data by creating a correlation matrix, calculating statistics, and visualizing the data. Which stage of the ML pipeline is the company currently in?

options.A: Data pre-processing
options.B: Feature engineering
options.C: Exploratory data analysis
options.D: Hyperparameter tuning

explanations.A: Incorrect. Data pre-processing 数据预处理: 错误。数据预处理通常包括清理数据、处理缺失值、标准化或归一化数据等操作，而题目中提到 的是分析数据和可视化数据，这属于探索性数据分析的范畴。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Feature engineering 特征工程: 错误。特征工程是从数据中提取或创建新的特征以提高模型性能的过程，而题目中并未提到特征的 创建或转换。
explanations.C: Correct. Exploratory data analysis 探索性数据分析: 正确。探索性数据分析（EDA）是对数据进行初步分析的阶段，包括创建相关矩阵、计算 统计量和可视化数据，这与题目描述完全一致。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Hyperparameter tuning 超参数调优: 错误。超参数调优是优化模型性能的过程，与题目中提到的数据分析和可视化无关。

question: A company has documents that are missing some words because of a database error. The company wants to build an ML model that can suggest potential words to fill in the missing text. Which type of model meets this requirement?

options.A: Topic modeling
options.B: Clustering models
options.C: Prescriptive ML models
options.D: BERT-based models

explanations.A: Incorrect. Topic modeling 主题建模 主题建模用于识别文档中的主题或主题分布，无法直接用于填充缺失的单词。此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Clustering models 聚类模型 聚类模型用于将数据分组到不同的类别中，通常用于无监督学习任务，与文本填充无直接关系。此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Prescriptive ML models 预测性机器学习模型 预测性模型通常用于提供建议或决策支持，但不是专⻔设计用于处理自然语言任务或填充缺失文本。此选项错误。
explanations.D: Correct. BERT-based models 基于BERT的模型 BERT是一种预训练的语言模型，擅⻓处理自然语言任务，包括文本填充和预测缺失单词。此选项正确。

question: A company wants to display the total sales for its top-selling products across various retail locations in the past 12 months. Which AWS solution should the company use to automate the generation of graphs?

options.A: Amazon Q in Amazon EC2 Amazon Q in Amazon EC2
options.B: Amazon Q Developer Amazon Q Developer
options.C: Amazon Q in Amazon QuickSight Amazon Q in Amazon QuickSight
options.D: Amazon Q in AWS Chatbot Amazon Q in AWS Chatbot

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon Q in Amazon EC2: 错误。Amazon EC2是一个计算服务，用于运行虚拟服务器实例，但它并不直接提供数据可视化功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon Q Developer: 错误。此选项并不是一个实际存在的AWS服务或工具，可能是虚构的选项。
explanations.C: Correct. Amazon Q in Amazon QuickSight: 正确。Amazon QuickSight是AWS的商业智能服务，专⻔用于数据分析和生成图表，适合自动化生成 销售数据的图表。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon Q in AWS Chatbot: 错误。AWS Chatbot是一个用于与AWS服务交互的工具，主要用于通知和操作，而不是数据可视化。

question: A company is building a chatbot to improve user experience. The company is using a large language model (LLM) from Amazon Bedrock for intent detection. The company wants to use few-shot learning to improve intent detection accuracy. Which additional data does the company need to meet these requirements?

options.A: Pairs of chatbot responses and correct user intents
options.B: Pairs of user messages and correct chatbot responses
options.C: Pairs of user messages and correct user intents
options.D: Pairs of user intents and correct chatbot responses

explanations.A: Incorrect. Pairs of chatbot responses and correct user intents 错误。聊天机器人响应与正确用戶意图的配对并不能直接帮助模型理解用戶消息的意图，因为Few-shot Learning需要的是用戶消息与 意图的直接关联，而不是机器人响应。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Pairs of user messages and correct chatbot responses 错误。用戶消息与正确聊天机器人响应的配对主要用于训练聊天机器人生成响应，而不是用于意图检测任务。此数据不符合Few- shot Learning的需求。
explanations.C: Correct. Pairs of user messages and correct user intents 正确。Few-shot Learning的目标是通过少量示例数据帮助模型理解任务。在意图检测任务中，用戶消息与正确用戶意图的配对是最直 接的训练数据，可以提高模型的意图检测准确性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Pairs of user intents and correct chatbot responses 错误。用戶意图与正确聊天机器人响应的配对主要用于生成响应，而不是用于意图检测任务。这种数据不适合Few-shot Learning的需 求。

question: A company is using few-shot prompting on a base model that is hosted on Amazon Bedrock. The model currently uses 10 examples in the prompt. The model is invoked once daily and is performing well. The company wants to lower the monthly cost. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Customize the model by using fine-tuning.
options.B: Decrease the number of tokens in the prompt.
options.C: Increase the number of tokens in the prompt.
options.D: Use Provisioned Throughput.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Customize the model by using fine-tuning. 微调模型可以提高性能，但通常需要额外的计算资源和成本，且不适合仅每天调用一次的场景。 此选项无法直接降低成本，因此错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Decrease the number of tokens in the prompt. 减少提示中的token数量可以直接降低调用成本，因为Amazon Bedrock的计费与token数量相关。 此选项符合题目要求，同时保持模型性能，因此正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Increase the number of tokens in the prompt. 增加token数量会提高调用成本，与题目要求降低成本相悖。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Use Provisioned Throughput. Provisioned Throughput适用于高频调用场景，可以优化性能，但对于每天仅调用一次的场景并不适用。 此选项无法降低成本，因此错误。

question: An AI practitioner is using a large language model (LLM) to create content for marketing campaigns. The generated content sounds plausible and factual but is incorrect. Which problem is the LLM having?

options.A: Data leakage
options.B: Hallucination
options.C: Overfitting
options.D: Underfitting

explanations.A: Incorrect. Data leakage 数据泄漏: 数据泄漏通常指的是模型在训练时意外使用了测试数据或其他不应包含的数据。这会导致模型在测试时表 现异常好，但与题目中描述的“生成内容看似合理但不正确”无关，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Hallucination 幻觉: 幻觉是指模型生成的内容虽然看起来合理，但实际上是错误的或虚构的。这正是题目中描述的问题，因此此选 项正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Overfitting 过拟合: 过拟合是指模型在训练数据上表现很好，但在新数据上表现较差。虽然过拟合可能导致模型生成不准确的内 容，但它与题目中描述的“生成内容看似合理但不正确”不完全匹配，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Underfitting 欠拟合: 欠拟合是指模型无法很好地学习训练数据，导致整体性能较差。与题目中描述的现象无关，因此此选项错误。

question: An AI practitioner trained a custom model on Amazon Bedrock by using a training dataset that contains confidential data. The AI practitioner wants to ensure that the custom model does not generate inference responses based on confidential data. How should the AI practitioner prevent responses based on confidential data?

options.A: Delete the custom model. Remove the confidential data from the training dataset. Retrain the custom model.
options.B: Mask the confidential data in the inference responses by using dynamic data masking.
options.C: Encrypt the confidential data in the inference responses by using Amazon SageMaker.
options.D: Encrypt the confidential data in the custom model by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

explanations.A: Correct. Delete the custom model. Remove the confidential data from the training dataset. Retrain the custom model. 正确：如果训练数据中包含机密信息，模型可能会在推理过程中泄露这些信息。最佳实践是删除模型，移除机密数据，并重新训练 模型以确保机密数据不会被使用。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Mask the confidential data in the inference responses by using dynamic data masking. 错误：动态数据屏蔽适用于数据库或实时数据处理，但无法解决模型已经学习到机密数据的问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Encrypt the confidential data in the inference responses by using Amazon SageMaker. 错误：加密推理响应无法防止模型生成基于机密数据的内容，因为问题的根源在于训练数据中包含机密信息。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Encrypt the confidential data in the custom model by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). 错误：加密模型本身无法解决机密数据泄露的问题，因为模型已经学习了机密数据。

question: A company has built a solution by using generative AI. The solution uses large language models (LLMs) to translate training manuals from English into other languages. The company wants to evaluate the accuracy of the solution by examining the text generated for the manuals. Which model evaluation strategy meets these requirements?

options.A: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU)
options.B: Root mean squared error (RMSE) Root mean squared error (RMSE)
options.C: Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE)
options.D: F1 score F1 score

explanations.A: Correct. Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) BLEU是一种常用的机器翻译评估指标，用于衡量生成文本与参考文本之间的相似度。 它通过计算n-gram的匹配程度来评估翻译质量，适合用于评估翻译任务的准确性。 此选项正确，因为它直接满足题目要求，即评估翻译文本的准确性。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Root mean squared error (RMSE) RMSE通常用于回归问题，衡量预测值与真实值之间的误差。 它不适用于评估文本生成任务的质量，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) ROUGE主要用于评估文本摘要任务，衡量生成文本与参考文本之间的覆盖率。 虽然ROUGE可以用于某些文本生成任务，但它更适合摘要而非翻译任务，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. F1 score F1分数是分类任务中的评估指标，用于衡量模型的精确率和召回率的平衡。 它不适用于评估生成式语言模型的翻译质量，因此此选项错误。

question: A large retailer receives thousands of customer support inquiries about products every day. The customer support inquiries need to be processed and responded to quickly. The company wants to implement Agents for Amazon Bedrock. What are the key benefits of using Amazon Bedrock agents that could help this retailer?

options.A: Generation of custom foundation models (FMs) to predict customer needs
options.B: Automation of repetitive tasks and orchestration of complex workflows
options.C: Automatically calling multiple foundation models (FMs) and consolidating the results
options.D: Selecting the foundation model (FM) based on predefined criteria and metrics

explanations.A: Incorrect. Generation of custom foundation models (FMs) to predict customer needs 错误：Amazon Bedrock的主要功能是提供预训练的基础模型（Foundation Models），而不是生成定制的基础模型。用戶可以使用现有 的模型进行推理和任务处理，但生成定制模型并不是其核心功能。
explanations.B: Correct. Automation of repetitive tasks and orchestration of complex workflows 正确：Amazon Bedrock支持通过Agents自动化重复性任务，并能够编排复杂的工作流程。这对于处理大量客戶支持请求非常有帮助。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Automatically calling multiple foundation models (FMs) and consolidating the results 错误：虽然Amazon Bedrock可以支持调用多个基础模型，但“整合结果”并不是其主要功能。题目中并未提到需要整合多个模型的结 果。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Selecting the foundation model (FM) based on predefined criteria and metrics 错误：Amazon Bedrock允许用戶选择适合的基础模型，但这不是题目中所描述的关键需求。题目更关注自动化和工作流编排，而不 是模型选择。

question: Which option is a benefit of ongoing pre-training when fine-tuning a foundation model (FM)?

options.A: Helps decrease the model's complexity
options.B: Improves model performance over time
options.C: Decreases the training time requirement
options.D: Optimizes model inference time

explanations.A: Incorrect. Helps decrease the model's complexity 有助于降低模型的复杂性 错误。持续预训练的主要目的是提高模型的性能，而不是直接降低模型的复杂性。模型复杂性通常与架构设计相关，而非训练过程 本身。
explanations.B: Correct. Improves model performance over time 随着时间推移提高模型性能 正确。持续预训练可以帮助模型不断学习新的数据或调整权重，从而随着时间推移提高模型的性能。这是持续预训练的核心优势。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Decreases the training time requirement 减少训练时间需求 错误。持续预训练通常需要额外的时间和资源，因此不会减少训练时间需求，反而可能增加训练时间。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Optimizes model inference time 优化模型推理时间 错误。持续预训练主要影响模型的训练阶段，而不是推理阶段。推理时间优化通常与模型架构和部署策略相关。

question: What are tokens in the context of generative AI models?

options.A: Tokens are the basic units of input and output that a generative AI model operates on, representing words, subwords, or other linguistic units.
options.B: Tokens are the mathematical representations of words or concepts used in generative AI models.
options.C: Tokens are the pre-trained weights of a generative AI model that are fine-tuned for specific tasks.
options.D: Tokens are the specific prompts or instructions given to a generative AI model to generate output.

explanations.A: Correct. Tokens are the basic units of input and output that a generative AI model operates on, representing words, subwords, or other linguistic units. 正确：这是对“Tokens”在生成式AI模型中的定义。Tokens是模型处理的基本单位，可以是单词、子单词或其他语言单位。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Tokens are the mathematical representations of words or concepts used in generative AI models. 错误：Tokens本身不是数学表示，而是语言单位。数学表示通常指嵌入（embeddings），是Tokens的进一步处理结果。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Tokens are the pre-trained weights of a generative AI model that are fine-tuned for specific tasks. 错误：Tokens不是模型的权重。权重是模型训练过程中学习到的参数，而Tokens是模型的输入和输出单位。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Tokens are the specific prompts or instructions given to a generative AI model to generate output. 错误：Tokens不是提示或指令。提示或指令是输入的一部分，而Tokens是输入被分解成的基本单位。

question: A company wants to assess the costs that are associated with using a large language model (LLM) to generate inferences. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock to build generative AI applications. Which factor will drive the inference costs?

options.A: Number of tokens consumed
options.B: Temperature value
options.C: Amount of data used to train the LLM
options.D: Total training time

explanations.A: Correct. Number of tokens consumed (消耗的tokens数量): 正确。推理成本通常与生成或处理的token数量直接相关。Amazon Bedrock的计费方 式通常基于模型处理的token数量，因此这是影响推理成本的主要因素。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Temperature value (Temperature值): 错误。Temperature值是生成式AI模型的超参数，用于控制生成文本的随机性或多样性，但它不 会直接影响推理成本。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amount of data used to train the LLM (用于训练LLM的数据量): 错误。训练数据量影响模型的训练成本，而不是推理成本。推理阶段 的成本与训练数据量无关。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Total training time (总训练时间): 错误。训练时间影响模型的训练成本，而不是推理成本。推理阶段的成本与训练时间无关。

question: A company is using Amazon SageMaker Studio notebooks to build and train ML models. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to manage the flow of data from Amazon S3 to SageMaker Studio notebooks. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Use Amazon Inspector to monitor SageMaker Studio.
options.B: Use Amazon Macie to monitor SageMaker Studio.
options.C: Configure SageMaker to use a VPC with an S3 endpoint.
options.D: Configure SageMaker to use S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Use Amazon Inspector to monitor SageMaker Studio. Amazon Inspector是一种自动化的安全评估服务，用于检查应用程序的安全漏洞。 它与数据流管理无关，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Use Amazon Macie to monitor SageMaker Studio. Amazon Macie是一种数据安全服务，用于识别和保护敏感数据。 它不能直接管理数据流，也与SageMaker Studio的网络配置无关，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Configure SageMaker to use a VPC with an S3 endpoint. 通过配置SageMaker使用VPC和S3 Endpoint，可以确保数据流直接从S3到SageMaker，而无需通过公共互联网。 这种方法提高了安全性和性能，是解决问题的正确方法。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Configure SageMaker to use S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive是一种⻓期存储解决方案，适用于不频繁访问的数据。 它不适合用于实时数据流管理，因此此选项错误。

question: A company has a foundation model (FM) that was customized by using Amazon Bedrock to answer customer queries about products. The company wants to validate the model's responses to new types of queries. The company needs to upload a new dataset that Amazon Bedrock can use for validation. Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 Amazon S3
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.D: AWS Snowcone AWS Snowcone

explanations.A: Correct. Amazon S3: Amazon S3 是 AWS 的对象存储服务，专为存储和检索任意数量的数据而设计。 它与 Amazon Bedrock 集成良好，可以用来存储数据集并供模型验证使用。 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS): Amazon EBS 是块存储服务，通常用于与 EC2 实例配合使用。 它不适合直接存储和管理数据集，也不与 Amazon Bedrock 直接集成。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS): Amazon EFS 是文件存储服务，适合共享文件系统的场景。 虽然它可以存储数据，但与 Amazon Bedrock 的集成性不如 Amazon S3。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS Snowcone: AWS Snowcone 是一种边缘计算设备，主要用于数据迁移和边缘存储。 它不适合直接用于上传数据集到 Amazon Bedrock。 此选项错误。

question: Which prompting attack directly exposes the configured behavior of a large language model (LLM)?

options.A: Prompted persona switches
options.B: Exploiting friendliness and trust
options.C: Ignoring the prompt template
options.D: Extracting the prompt template

explanations.A: Incorrect. Prompted persona switches 提示⻆色切换 错误：提示⻆色切换是通过改变模型的⻆色或语气来影响其输出，但它并不直接暴露模型的配置行为。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Exploiting friendliness and trust 利用友善和信任 错误：利用模型的友善和信任通常是为了诱导模型生成特定的输出，而不是直接暴露其配置行为。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Ignoring the prompt template 忽略提示模板 错误：忽略提示模板可能会导致模型输出不符合预期，但它并不涉及直接提取或暴露模型的配置行为。
explanations.D: Correct. Extracting the prompt template 提取提示模板 正确：提取提示模板是通过攻击直接暴露模型的配置行为，例如获取模型的预定义指令或规则。

question: A company wants to use Amazon Bedrock. The company needs to review which security aspects the company is responsible for when using Amazon Bedrock. Which security aspect will the company be responsible for?

options.A: Patching and updating the versions of Amazon Bedrock
options.B: Protecting the infrastructure that hosts Amazon Bedrock
options.C: Securing the company's data in transit and at rest
options.D: Provisioning Amazon Bedrock within the company network

explanations.A: Incorrect. Patching and updating the versions of Amazon Bedrock错误：根据AWS共享责任模型，AWS负责管理和维护其服务的底层基础设施，包括修补和更新服务版本。客戶无需负责Amazon Bedrock的版本更新。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Protecting the infrastructure that hosts Amazon Bedrock错误：AWS负责保护其托管服务的基础设施，包括物理安全、网络安全等。客戶不需要负责托管Amazon Bedrock的基础设施安全。
explanations.C: Correct. Securing the company's data in transit and at rest正确：根据AWS共享责任模型，客戶负责保护自己的数据，包括数据的传输安全（加密）和静态安全（存储加密）。这是客戶的责 任。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Provisioning Amazon Bedrock within the company network错误：Amazon Bedrock是AWS托管的服务，客戶无需在自己的网络中配置该服务。客戶只需通过AWS管理控制台或API使用该服务。

question: A social media company wants to use a large language model (LLM) to summarize messages. The company has chosen a few LLMs that are available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. The company wants to compare the generated output toxicity of these models. Which strategy gives the company the ability to evaluate the LLMs with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Crowd-sourced evaluation
options.B: Automatic model evaluation
options.C: Model evaluation with human workers
options.D: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)

explanations.A: Incorrect. Crowd-sourced evaluation 众包评估 众包评估依赖于大量的外部人员参与，虽然可以提供多样化的反馈，但需要协调和管理众包任务，增加了操作开销。因此不符合“最 少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. Automatic model evaluation 自动模型评估 自动模型评估使用预定义的算法或工具来评估模型输出的毒性。这种方法不需要人工干预，操作开销最低，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Model evaluation with human workers 使用人工工作人员进行模型评估 使用人工工作人员进行评估需要雇佣和管理人员，虽然评估质量可能较高，但操作开销显著增加，因此不符合“最少操作开销”的要 求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF） RLHF是一种复杂的技术，需要大量的人工反馈和训练过程，操作开销较高，不符合题目要求。

question: A company is testing the security of a foundation model (FM). During testing, the company wants to get around the safety features and make harmful content. Which security technique is this an example of?

options.A: Fuzzing training data to find vulnerabilities
options.B: Denial of service (DoS)
options.C: Penetration testing with authorization
options.D: Jailbreak

explanations.A: Incorrect. Fuzzing training data to find vulnerabilities 模糊测试训练数据以发现漏洞 错误：模糊测试通常是通过向系统输入随机或异常数据来发现漏洞，但本题的重点是绕过模型的安全机制，而不是测试训练数据的 漏洞。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Denial of service (DoS) 拒绝服务（DoS） 错误：DoS攻击是通过大量请求使系统无法正常工作，与绕过安全机制生成有害内容无关。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Penetration testing with authorization 授权的渗透测试 错误：授权的渗透测试是模拟攻击以发现系统漏洞，但本题强调的是绕过模型的安全机制，而不是授权测试。
explanations.D: Correct. Jailbreak 越狱 正确：越狱是指绕过模型的安全限制以执行未授权的操作，例如生成有害内容。这正是题目描述的行为。

question: A company needs to use Amazon SageMaker for model training and inference. The company must comply with regulatory requirements to run SageMaker jobs in an isolated environment without internet access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run SageMaker training and inference by using SageMaker Experiments.
options.B: Run SageMaker training and Inference by using network Isolation.
options.C: Encrypt the data at rest by using encryption for SageMaker geospatial capabilities.
options.D: Associate appropriate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles with the SageMaker jobs.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Run SageMaker training and inference by using SageMaker Experiments. 错误：SageMaker Experiments主要用于组织和跟踪机器学习实验，而不是用于网络隔离或满足监管要求。
explanations.B: Correct. Run SageMaker training and Inference by using network Isolation. 正确：网络隔离是满足监管要求的关键措施。通过使用VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）和禁用互联网访问，可以确保SageMaker作业在隔 离环境中运行。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Encrypt the data at rest by using encryption for SageMaker geospatial capabilities. 错误：数据加密是安全性的一部分，但它并不能解决网络隔离的问题，也不是本题的核心要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Associate appropriate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles with the SageMaker jobs. 错误：IAM⻆色用于权限管理，但它不能直接实现网络隔离或满足监管要求。

question: An ML research team develops custom ML models. The model artifacts are shared with other teams for integration into products and services. The ML team retains the model training code and data. The ML team wants to build a mechanism that the ML team can use to audit models. Which solution should the ML team use when publishing the custom ML models?

options.A: Create documents with the relevant information. Store the documents in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use AWS AI Service Cards for transparency and understanding models.
options.C: Create Amazon SageMaker Model Cards with intended uses and training and inference details.
options.D: Create model training scripts. Commit the model training scripts to a Git repository.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Create documents with the relevant information. Store the documents in Amazon S3. 错误：虽然将文档存储在Amazon S3可以保存相关信息，但这种方法缺乏结构化的方式来记录模型的详细信息（如训练数据、推理细 节等），不适合用于审计。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Use AWS AI Service Cards for transparency and understanding models. 错误：AWS AI Service Cards是用于帮助理解AWS AI服务的透明性工具，而不是用于记录自定义机器学习模型的详细信息。
explanations.C: Correct. Create Amazon SageMaker Model Cards with intended uses and training and inference details. 正确：Amazon SageMaker Model Cards是专⻔设计用于记录机器学习模型的详细信息，包括预期用途、训练数据、推理细节等。这种 结构化的方式非常适合审计和共享模型信息。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Create model training scripts. Commit the model training scripts to a Git repository. 错误：虽然将训练脚本提交到Git代码库可以保存代码版本，但它并不能记录模型的详细信息（如训练数据、推理细节等），不适合 用于审计。

question: A software company builds tools for customers. The company wants to use AI to increase software development productivity. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a binary classification model to generate code reviews.
options.B: Install code recommendation software in the company's developer tools.
options.C: Install a code forecasting tool to predict potential code issues.
options.D: Use a natural language processing (NLP) tool to generate code.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用二元分类模型生成代码审查。 二元分类模型通常用于解决二分类问题，例如垃圾邮件检测或情感分析。生成代码审查并不是二元分类模型的典型应用场景。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。
explanations.B: Correct. 在公司的开发工具中安装代码推荐软件。 代码推荐软件可以通过分析代码上下文，为开发者提供代码片段建议，从而提高开发效率。 此选项直接满足题目要求，是正确答案。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 安装代码预测工具以预测潜在的代码问题。 代码预测工具通常用于检测代码中的潜在问题或漏洞，但这并不能直接提高开发生产力，而是更偏向于质量保证。 此选项与题目要求不完全匹配，错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用自然语言处理（NLP）工具生成代码。 NLP工具可以用于代码生成，但生成的代码质量和适用性可能有限，且需要额外的验证和调整。 此选项虽然涉及AI技术，但不如代码推荐软件直接满足生产力提升的需求，错误。

question: A retail store wants to predict the demand for a specific product for the next few weeks by using the Amazon SageMaker DeepAR forecasting algorithm. Which type of data will meet this requirement?

options.A: Text data
options.B: Image data
options.C: Time series data
options.D: Binary data

explanations.A: Incorrect. Text data 文本数据: 错误。DeepAR算法不适用于文本数据。文本数据通常用于自然语言处理（NLP）任务，而不是时间序列预测。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Image data 图像数据: 错误。图像数据通常用于计算机视觉任务，例如图像分类或目标检测，而不是时间序列预测。
explanations.C: Correct. Time series data 时间序列数据: 正确。DeepAR算法专⻔设计用于时间序列数据的预测，例如产品需求、销售量或天气变化等。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Binary data 二进制数据: 错误。二进制数据通常用于存储文件或数据流，而不是时间序列预测。

question: A large retail bank wants to develop an ML system to help the risk management team decide on loan allocations for different demographics. What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model?

options.A: Reduce the size of the training dataset.
options.B: Ensure that the ML model predictions are consistent with historical results.
options.C: Create a different ML model for each demographic group.
options.D: Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Reduce the size of the training dataset. 减少训练数据集的大小。 错误原因： 减少训练数据集的大小可能会导致模型性能下降，因 为模型需要足够的数据来学习特征。减少数据集大小并不能解决偏差问题，反而可能加剧问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Ensure that the ML model predictions are consistent with historical results. 确保ML模型预测与历史结果一致。 错误原因： 历史数据可 能本身就存在偏差。如果模型仅仅依赖历史数据进行预测，可能会继承这些偏差，而不是解决问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Create a different ML model for each demographic group. 为每个人口群体创建一个不同的ML模型。 错误原因： 为每个群体创建单独 的模型可能会导致过度拟合，并且难以维护多个模型。更重要的是，这种方法可能会引入新的偏差，而不是解决现有问题。
explanations.D: Correct. Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly. 测量训练数据集中的类别不平衡情况，并相应 地调整训练过程。 正确原因： 类别不平衡是导致模型偏差的常⻅原因。通过测量类别不平衡并调整训练过程（例如使用加权损失函 数或过采样/欠采样技术），可以有效减少模型的偏差并提高公平性。

question: Which prompting technique can protect against prompt injection attacks?

options.A: Adversarial prompting Adversarial prompting
options.B: Zero-shot prompting Zero-shot prompting
options.C: Least-to-most prompting Least-to-most prompting
options.D: Chain-of-thought prompting Chain-of-thought prompting

explanations.A: Correct. Adversarial prompting: 正确。Adversarial prompting是一种技术，通过模拟潜在的攻击场景来测试模型的鲁棒性，从而帮助识别和防 范提示注入攻击。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Zero-shot prompting: 错误。Zero-shot prompting是指在没有任何示例的情况下直接给模型提示，这种方法并不专⻔针对提示注入攻 击的防护。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Least-to-most prompting: 错误。Least-to-most prompting是一种逐步引导模型解决问题的技术，与防护提示注入攻击无关。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Chain-of-thought prompting: 错误。Chain-of-thought prompting是通过引导模型逐步推理来提高回答质量，但它并不直接涉及防护提 示注入攻击。

question: A company has fine-tuned a large language model (LLM) to answer questions for a help desk. The company wants to determine if the fine-tuning has enhanced the model's accuracy. Which metric should the company use for the evaluation?

options.A: Precision Precision
options.B: Time to first token Time to first token
options.C: F1 score F1 score
options.D: Word error rate Word error rate

explanations.A: Incorrect. Precision: Precision（精确率）是一个重要的指标，用于衡量模型预测的正样本中有多少是真正的正样本。然而，单独使用 Precision可能无法全面反映模型的性能，特别是在需要综合考虑Precision和Recall的场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Time to first token: Time to first token（生成第一个Token的时间）是一个性能指标，通常用于评估模型的响应速度，而不是模型的准 确性。因此，这个选项与题目要求不符。
explanations.C: Correct. F1 score: F1 score是Precision和Recall的调和平均值，能够综合评估模型的性能，特别是在需要平衡Precision和Recall的场景。对于 评估模型的准确性，F1 score是一个合适的选择。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Word error rate: Word error rate（词错误率）通常用于评估语音识别或翻译模型的性能，而不是用于评估问答模型的准确性。因此， 这个选项不适合本题场景。

question: A company is using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with Amazon Bedrock and Stable Diffusion to generate product images based on text descriptions. The results are often random and lack specific details. The company wants to increase the specificity of the generated images. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Increase the number of generation steps.
options.B: Use the MASK_IMAGE_BLACK mask source option.
options.C: Increase the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale.
options.D: Increase the prompt strength.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Increase the number of generation steps. 增加生成步骤的数量。 分析：增加生成步骤可以提高图像的质量，但它主要影响的是图像的清晰度和细节，而不是图像的具体性和针对性。因此，这个选 项不能完全解决问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Use the MASK_IMAGE_BLACK mask source option. 使用MASK_IMAGE_BLACK掩码源选项。 分析：MASK_IMAGE_BLACK选项通常用于图像修复或特定区域的生成，与提高图像的具体性无直接关系。因此，这个选项不适合解 决问题。
explanations.C: Correct. Increase the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. 增加classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale。 分析：CFG scale 是一个关键参数，用于控制生成模型对提示的依赖程度。增加CFG scale可以让模型更严格地遵循输入的提示，从而 提高图像的具体性和细节。这是解决问题的正确方法。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Increase the prompt strength. 提高提示强度。 分析：提高提示强度可以让模型更关注输入的提示，但它的效果通常不如调整CFG scale直接和显著。提示强度的调整可能会导致生 成结果过于偏向某些特定特征，而失去整体平衡。

question: A company wants to implement a large language model (LLM) based chatbot to provide customer service agents with real-time contextual responses to customers' inquiries. The company will use the company's policies as the knowledge base. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Retrain the LLM on the company policy data.
options.B: Fine-tune the LLM on the company policy data.
options.C: Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for in-context responses.
options.D: Use pre-training and data augmentation on the company policy data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Retrain the LLM on the company policy data. 重新训练LLM需要大量的计算资源和时间，成本非常高。 重新训练通常用于从头开始训练模型，而不是针对特定任务或数据进行优化。 此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求，因此错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Fine-tune the LLM on the company policy data. 微调是一个较为经济的选择，因为它只需要对预训练模型进行小规模调整。 然而，微调仍然需要一定的计算资源，并且可能无法实时处理动态数据。 虽然比重新训练成本低，但仍不是最具成本效益的解决方案，因此错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for in-context responses. RAG结合了检索和生成技术，可以实时从知识库中检索相关信息并生成上下文响应。 这种方法不需要重新训练或微调模型，直接利用现有的知识库，成本效益高。 符合题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Use pre-training and data augmentation on the company policy data. 预训练和数据增强通常用于构建新的模型或扩展模型的能力。 此方法需要大量计算资源和时间，成本较高。 不符合“最具成本效益”的要求，因此错误。

options.B: AWS Config AWS Config

question: A company is developing a mobile ML app that uses a phone's camera to diagnose and treat insect bites. The company wants to train an image classification model by using a diverse dataset of insect bite photos from different genders, ethnicities, and geographic locations around the world. Which principle of responsible AI does the company demonstrate in this scenario?

options.A: Fairness
options.B: Explainability
options.C: Governance
options.D: Transparency

explanations.A: Correct. Fairness 公平性: 正确。公司通过使用来自不同性别、种族和地理位置的多样化数据集来训练模型，确保模型不会对某些群体产生 偏⻅。这体现了公平性原则。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Explainability 可解释性: 错误。可解释性指的是模型的决策过程是否可以被人类理解，而题目中并未提到与模型解释相关的内容。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Governance 治理: 错误。治理涉及对AI系统的管理和监督，确保其符合法律法规和道德标准。题目中没有提到治理相关的内容。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Transparency 透明性: 错误。透明性指的是AI系统的工作方式是否公开透明，题目中没有提到与透明性相关的内容。
